items.title: 67848_Jimmy McPartland oral history interview
items.q: greatest influence on the cornet was first Paul Mares with the New Orleans Rhythm Kings.

ctx.x: We were so inspired that that's all we did. We just played music every day, every day and every night. Every day and every night. And naturally my
greatest influence on the cornet was first Paul Mares with the New Orleans Rhythm Kings.
Now was that a negro band?
